title: SENeCA digital neuromorphic processor (imec)
summary: The page describes SENeca as a RISC-V-based digital neuromorphic processor developed by imec for extreme edge applications. It accelerates Spiking Neural Networks near sensors, leveraging biological properties like spatio-temporal sparsity and asynchronous execution. The architecture features fully programmable neuron models and learning algorithms suitable for academic research.
tldr: SENeCA is an RISC-V-based digital neuromorphic processor by imec designed to accelerate Spiking Neural Networks in ultra-low power edge applications with programmable adaptivity.
evidence: SENeCA is a RISC-V-based digital neuromorphic processor targeting extreme edge applications by accelerating Spiking Neural Networks inside or near sensors and small devices where ultra-low power and adaptivity are required.

It inherits fundamental properties from the biological brain: spatio-temporal sparsity exploitation, parallel processing, infinite scalability, low-precision parameters, asynchronous non-deterministic execution, adaptation and fault-tolerance architecture.
